description: MainActivity.java for an Android MIDI synthesizer app, managing MIDI device connection, UI interactions, and lifecycle.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for MIDI synthesizer app, handling MIDI setup, UI, and lifecycle.
